description:
The startup banner format and version display differ between implementations.

OBSERVED (Elixir - left):
==> octo_pi_tui_terminal
make: Nothing to be done for `all`.

 octo_pi v0.1.0
 escape interrupt · ctrl+c/ctrl+d clear/exit · / commands · ? more

Note: Shows 'octo_pi v0.1.0' (project name), and there's a build message 'make: Nothing to be done for `all`.'

EXPECTED (Node.js - right):
 pi v0.73.0
 escape interrupt · ctrl+c/ctrl+d clear/exit · / commands · ! bash · ctrl+o more
 Press ctrl+o to show full startup help and loaded resources.

Note: Shows 'pi v0.73.0' (generic name), no build messages, cleaner separation.

Issues:
1. The 'make: Nothing to be done for `all`.' message should not appear in the TUI output
2. Version is 'octo_pi v0.1.0' vs 'pi v0.73.0' - different naming and versioning scheme
3. The project should probably show 'pi' not 'octo_pi' to match the Node.js branding
title: TUI-8: Different startup banner format and version display
